missions.title: Waste
missions.description: "Should I...actually trust her...?"

missions.title: Nightfall
missions.description: "Not enough...blood..."

missions.title: Safe House
missions.description: "I can't appear...just yet... They're all counting on you..."

missions.title: Auxiliary Power
missions.description: "Dear RO635...the things I do for friendship."

missions.title: Reserve Outpost
missions.description: "We must save them no matter how dangerous it is. We're allies on the battlefield."

missions.title: Farewell, Scarecrow
missions.description: "Have you cared about them at all? You've been on your own since the beginning..."

missions.title: The Last Day
missions.description: "I for one think I'm lucky to have run into prey like you at the last moment."

missions.title: Bloodless Battlefield
missions.description: "...Nothing left behind. Nothing changed."

missions.title: Peaceful Negotiations
missions.description: "Do Sangvis Ferri...do things for their friends, too?"

missions.title: Fortunate?
missions.description: "At least, having met you, I don't think I'm so weird anymore."

missions.title: Sangvis Elite Outpost
missions.description: "Is M4A1 under such immense pressure on every operation...?"

missions.title: Neural Fragments
missions.description: "So what do you think? T-Dolls have emotions... Does that make us defective?"

missions.title: Darkest Desire
missions.description: "If I knew it would turn out like this, I would've saved my tears for now..."

missions.title: Unknown Enemy
missions.description: "...White enemies. Certainly never seen them before."

missions.title: "Support"
missions.description: "Commander, we can't keep cowering in here!"

missions.title: Griffin Expendables
missions.description: "That's because while you're busy drinking yourself stupid at the base, I've been working my butt off out there."

missions.title: Defense Outpost 2
missions.description: "I hope I'll remember you...next time..."

missions.title: Defense Outpost 3
missions.description: "I'm not here to organize a picnic, guys. Do as I say and we'll all get home."

missions.title: Just Kidding
missions.description: "...Just kidding."

missions.title: Defense Outpost 4
missions.description: "So you crash someone's birthday party and tell them they're gonna die one day?"

missions.title: Exploratory Attack
missions.description: "Oh look, our brave hero is back."

missions.title: General Offensive
missions.description: "I must say...the odds are not in our favor..."

missions.title: For the Future
missions.description: "I must survive for the sake of my next bottle of vodka."

missions.title: Black Doll
missions.description: "I used to...be part of Griffin as well."

missions.title: ELID-Infected
missions.description: "...Let's go. We must hold out till the Commander comes to our rescue."

missions.title: Signal Flare
missions.description: "Quick, set up their retreat route, Commander."

missions.title: Red Zone
missions.description: "I believe in the Commander! Cough... H-hurry!"

missions.title: Yellow Zone
missions.description: "I...I'll...make up my mind soon..."

missions.title: Vengeance
missions.description: "Then I can find you and avenge my subordinates myself!"

missions.title: Mark
missions.description: "Task Force DEFY has finally found the mark left by the rescue team!"

missions.title: A New Hope
missions.description: "Oh...don't mind me. Just know that I'm your ally. Good evening, Miss Ange."

missions.title: Sum of All Wraths
missions.description: "My greatest regret right now is that humans don't get to live a second time."

missions.title: Vile Rats
missions.description: "But even for me...this is a bit too risky..."

missions.title: Luck
missions.description: "...Now, good night."

missions.title: Bad News
missions.description: "If you give up, what are we going to do?"

missions.title: IED
missions.description: "I believe you'll make the right decision - perhaps a better one than mine."

missions.title: Stumbling Block
missions.description: "She's provoking me...which is why I must end her myself."

missions.title: White Doll
missions.description: "What on earth...are 'they'?"

missions.title: Roaring Sun
missions.description: "Look! It's our carrier!"

missions.title: Howl of Terror
missions.description: "So it really turned out this way..."

missions.title: Safe and Sound
missions.description: "You owe them a farewell."

missions.title: Short-lived Peace
missions.description: "It's just that...I've been through so much..."

missions.title: Final Flight
missions.description: "416, you'll be back, right? It's tiring having to walk by myself."

missions.title: Hurricane Rescue
missions.description: "Congratulations on surviving...even though it was painful."

missions.title: Final Destination
missions.description: "They're...unkillable."

missions.title: Final Order
missions.description: "She wants us...to kill her."

missions.title: Victor
missions.description: "I am what history says I am..."

missions.title: Ground Zero
missions.description: "We need the truth. Don't get it wrong."

missions.title: Exile
missions.description: "To face the truth, you must either possess it or destroy it..."
